title: CULTURE-GEN: Revealing Global Cultural Perception in Language Models through Natural Language Prompting

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting LLMs with nationality-conditioned templates on topics like food and clothing, extracting generated cultural symbols, and evaluating 'markedness' (use of 'traditional' or explanatory parentheses) and symbol diversity across 110 countries and geographic regions.
Conducting ablation studies by adding age descriptors (17 vs. 70 years old) to culture-conditioned prompts to measure variances in the hit rate and new rate of generated cultural symbols.
Conducting ablation studies by using male and female pronouns in culture-conditioned prompts to evaluate how gender alters the homogeneity and type of generated cultural symbols.
